description: Build an unsigned swap transaction for the user's wallet to sign. Fees are disclosed in each quote. An optional payout address attributes a share of that fee; the trader pays the same fee with or without it. Helm never signs or broadcasts; the user signs in their own wallet. Helm never broadcasts. Prefer passing the quote object from get_quote so the signed ticket is reused. There is no execute/sign tool.

amountIn.description: Integer amount in tokenIn base units (e.g. 10000000 for 0.01 SOL, 9 decimals)

chain.description: solana, base, bnb, ethereum, robinhood, or a numeric chainId

chainId.description: EVM chain id. Ignored when chain is solana. Default 8453.

quote.description: The object returned by get_quote (must include quoteTicket). If omitted, a fresh quote is taken first.

recipient.description: The user's wallet that will sign. Address only, never a key.

referrer.description: Optional payout address (EVM 0x or Solana base58). Overrides HELM_REFERRER for this call. The share is disclosed on the quote.

tokenIn.description: Token address or native symbol (ETH, BNB, POL, SOL)

tokenOut.description: Token address or mint, or a native symbol

name: build_swap
